provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

definition: Functional distance is the absolute difference of supplied one-dimensional trait values. Rao Q=sum_i sum_j p_i*p_j*d_ij, including zero diagonal and both off-diagonal orientations. It is the expected absolute trait difference between two independent abundance-weighted draws with replacement. Count positive abundance taxa for richness.
scope: Controlled communities on an explicitly stipulated trait scale; neither entropy nor squared Euclidean distances answers this functional-distance target. No uncertainty or causal environmental interpretation is supplied.
